name: Skeleton
description: Widgets-only loading placeholder with a repeating shimmer sweep; replaces the banned skeletonizer package.

fields.fromColor: ThemedColor? - leading sweep fill; null = muted
fields.toColor: ThemedColor? - trailing sweep fill; null = accent
fields.duration: Duration? - one sweep; null = 2 x kDefaultDuration

notes: `package:skeletonizer` is banned; the shimmer is a `ShaderMask` gradient driven by `RepeatedAnimationBuilder`.
`ShadcnSkeletonizerConfigLayer` is gone: it required a `material.ThemeData` and only forwarded `SkeletonizerConfigData`.

The `Widget` extension (`asSkeleton`, `asSkeletonSliver`, `ignoreSkeleton`, `excludeSkeleton`) and the `Skeleton.leaf/unite/replace/ignore/keep` factories are deleted: they existed only to configure skeletonizer's subtree walk and had no reader outside the component.
`avatar` is not a dependency any more: the old `asSkeleton` type test `this is Avatar` only picked a skeletonizer mode and is not needed to paint a placeholder.
